name: Girisim Elektrik Sanayi Taahhut Ve Ticaret A.s.
summary: Girisim Elektrik Sanayi Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S. operates as an EPC company in Turkey and internationally. The company operates through Enterprise, Europower, Peak PV, EP World, Euromek, and Peakesco segments. It offers EPC services for HV and MV substations, electric distribution networks, transmission lines, thermal and hydroelectrical power plants, hydroelectric and wind power plants, geothermal and biomass power plants, combined cycle natural gas power plants, cogeneration, railways and industrial facility electrification, infrastructure and super structure projects, power factor correction, and automation and SCADA projects. The company also provides engineering services, such as project design and management, supervision, and testing and commissioning, as well as training services. In addition, it offers LV switch gears, LV-MV power factor correction devices and reactors, automation and SCADA equipment, data recorders, power protection and control equipment, LV panels, MV cells, concrete and metallic kiosks, compact and packaged substations, testing and measurement equipment, power and distribution transformers and accessories, LV-MV-HV measurement and protection transformers, MV-HV circuit breakers, disconnectors, gas insulated switch gears, UPS, voltage regulators, cables and cable accessories, MV-fuses, insulators, power transmission and distribution equipment, neutral earthing resistors, conductors, motor and drives, surge arresters, lightning and over-voltage protection equipment, cable trays and busbar systems, grounding equipment, steel and concrete poles, power generation systems and products, lighting equipment, electrical installation equipment, electrical products, transformer oils, railway catenary and electrification equipment, solar panels, inverters, solar energy mounting systems and structures, and battery systems; and health, safety, and environmental equipment. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
